title: Generate authoritative project-status artifacts and fail CI on stale README/PROJECT_KNOWLEDGE claims

required_proof_map.requirement: deterministic same-input generation (byte-identical apart from generated_at)

required_proof_map.evidence: docs/status/github-snapshot.json + CURRENT_STATE.json: branch_protection enabled, open [72,180,221,222,223,224,225], recently_completed [211..220]

required_proof_map.requirement: mutating a source without regenerating fails the freshness verifier
required_proof_map.evidence: CLI: verify vs mutated github-snapshot -> status FAIL, source_drift:github_snapshot, exit 1; tests test_source_mutation_without_rebuild_fails_verifier, test_github_snapshot_edit_without_rebuild_fails_verifier

required_proof_map.requirement: mutating generated status text without changing bound source digest fails validation
GitHub unavailable path reports degraded/stale, does not fail offline use
required_proof_map.evidence: test_offline_reports_degraded_not_green: github.freshness=STALE, fields UNKNOWN, verify passes

required_proof_map.requirement: README/PROJECT_KNOWLEDGE carry a bounded generated section; historical prose cannot masquerade as current
required_proof_map.evidence: AUTHORITATIVE STATUS LINK blocks in README.md and PROJECT_KNOWLEDGE.md link docs/status/CURRENT_STATE.md as the authority

required_proof_map.requirement: package description updated and tested through package metadata
CI verifies generated status freshness on changes to tracked source inputs
required_proof_map.evidence: .github/workflows/project-status-freshness.yml (verify + rendered-digest match, path-filtered on bound sources)

required_proof_map.requirement: retained receipt states mocked/live/provider_live, checked, not_checked
no runtime authority (does not settle workflows/admit receipts/change goal)
required_proof_map.evidence: project_status.py is read-only over sources; render states 'carries no runtime authority'

artifacts.semantic_content_digest: see docs/status/CURRENT_STATE.json (bound at generation; not embedded here to avoid a self-referential proof-index cycle)

proves: tau project-status build/render/verify generate a deterministic, source-digest-bound current-state artifact from explicit sources; drift in any bound source or in the generated text is detected and fails CI; offline builds degrade to STALE/UNKNOWN rather than inferring green; README/PROJECT_KNOWLEDGE defer to the generated block.
does_not_prove: That every historical prose claim elsewhere in the repo has been individually corrected (non-goal: no arbitrary historical-prose editing).
